batchIdsExpiry: Batch IDs and expiry/opened details come from the API. The API validates the entered observations and total.
correctObservedNow: Correct the stock you observe now. The original Add Item event stays in history.
itemNotAtLocation: This item is not on this location checklist. Return to Item Detail and choose a current stock location.
itemsAppearHere: Items appear here when their stock or preferred placement belongs to
locationChecklistLoaded: Location checklist could not be loaded:
currentBackupStock: No current or backup stock fields are assigned to this location.
itemsAssignedLocation: No items are assigned to this location
openingTrackingApi: Opening tracking is on. The API validates whole package counts and opened batch limits.
checklistReturnCurrent: The checklist did not return current batch details, so batch correction is unavailable until the API provides them.
changesOnlyStock: This changes only stock assigned to this location. It does not change batches elsewhere.
stockChangedSinceCheck: Stock changed since the last check
stockRecordOld: This stock record is over 30 days old
batchCountsRequired: The API needs a count for each positive batch at this location. Review the batch details below.
stockChangedReviewAgain: Stock changed before this check was saved. The list was refreshed; review the latest values and decide again.
locationCheckSaveFailed: The location check could not be saved.
savedRefreshFailed: The correction was saved, but some views could not refresh. Check Item Detail or reload before making another change.
noLocationStockRecord: No stock record at this location
invalidObservation: Enter the stock you observed before saving.
invalidRevision: The stock revision is missing or invalid. Reload this item before trying again.
invalidDecision: The stock decision is invalid. Reload this item before trying again.
invalidQuantity: Enter a nonnegative quantity with no more than six decimal places.
invalidBatchCounts: Enter one count for every active batch here. An unopened batch cannot be increased; use additional unopened quantity instead.
invalidBatchCount: Each batch count must be nonnegative with no more than six decimal places.
batchTotalMismatch: The total must equal the batch counts plus any additional unopened quantity.
invalidExtraQuantity: Additional unopened quantity must be nonnegative with no more than six decimal places.
invalidExtraExpiry: Enter a valid expiry date only when adding unopened stock.
invalidPackageCount: Unopened stock must be whole packages, and an opened batch cannot exceed one package.
invalidPresence: Choose whether the current item is present or absent.
invalidBackupCount: Enter a nonnegative whole number of backups.
fieldNotAtLocation: That stock is assigned to another location. Choose its location from Item Detail.
itemArchived: This item is archived. Restore it before correcting stock.
